messages:
toni: Heads-up — small docs regression: PR #10211 changed the 429 example flow in docs/error-ref/429.md. CI shows a snippet failure and a broken reference to sdk/py/retries.md

rahul: Got the CI link. Snippet harness: KeyError on header 'retry-after'. Runtime now emits 'retry-after-ms'. Also token util import path changed (token_utils -> tokens.count_tokens).

olga: I approved the wording change earlier; didn't realize examples touched low-level headers. I'll fix the broken reference.

doc-bot: Build 7162 failed — 1 broken link, 1 snippet failure (docs/error-ref/429.md).

toni: Suggested fix: 1) normalize headers in snippets (ms preferred, fallback to seconds); 2) update token import path; 3) move long-hosted repro to docs/tests/mock_server so snippet tests are deterministic.

rahul: I'll push a small Python patch that normalizes headers and provides sync/async variants. Also add a tiny helper normalize_retry(resp.headers).

olga: Please include a short table at top mapping cause -> mitigation (surge -> backoff+retry-after; sustained QPS -> route to dedicated; too-large prompts -> trim oldest turns). Support relies on these quick references.

doc-bot: Link fix pushed by olga (branch docs/429-linkfix). Build triggered: #7163.

rahul: Pushed snippet patch to docs/py-429-normalize. Also switched the snippet test to use docs/tests/mock_server.py.

ci-bot: Build #7164 started.

ci-bot: Build #7164 failed — lint: async code used in sync block in snippet. Update to show both variants.

rahul: Fixed to include explicit sync and async snippets. Pushed.

ci-bot: Build #7165 success — all snippet tests passed.

toni: Final items before merge: add CHANGELOG blurb, add contributing guide checklist to verify runtime header names and run snippet harness locally, and note that trimming isn't guaranteed to fix all 429s (mention QPS/model caps).

olga: Added CHANGELOG and contributing note. Squashed and merged PR #10211. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
